description: A short celebrity run moves through cycling, steam power, metallurgy, automotive vocabulary and science-fiction cinema, finding quiz-worthy specificity in subjects that range from everyday machinery to fictional spacecraft.

s07e01.description: Toast ‘soldiers’, PhDs, rock-paper-scissors, Snow White’s Whistle While You Work, protein and barracudas all feature before cycling terminology supplies the peloton. A doctorate and breakfast toast are treated with identical seriousness.

s07e02.description: G and Ts, ‘my lips are sealed’, the radio word Roger, Pepe Le Pew, UCAS and Garra rufa fish pedicures all appear before transport history brings in the steam locomotive.

s07e03.description: Refrigerators, tornadoes, Kleenex, haiku, Peggy Mitchell from EastEnders, Ireland’s Garda, the foam on lager and travel writer Bill Bryson all appear before material science contributes stainless steel.

s07e04.description: Minibars, Scrabble, cervelat sausage, clerical dog collars, Rambo, Christopher Robin and the phrase ‘emotional rollercoaster’ all enter the question set. Automotive maintenance then gives the humble dipstick an improbable moment of prime-time importance.

s07e05.description: Alexander Armstrong faces questions on Grease’s Rydell High, the aorta, Edam, Destiny’s Child, Discovery One from 2001 and the Piltdown Man hoax; Gabby Logan’s half ranges through Trainspotting, blue whales, Paddington’s Windsor Gardens address and Degas.
